text:
Marco: FYI we just had a tenant overflow from Dedicated -> Hosted in eu-west and they hit an SLA/price surprise. Need quick decision on how we expose that in Console and telemetry.
Amy: Oof. Do we currently mark those requests any differently in logs? customers are asking for an audit trail.
Kevin: We do emit routing_decision in traces but Console doesn't show it per-request. Only aggregates. We can add a per-request field 'served_from'.
Sai: Routing code: we distinguish variant fallback vs capacity spillover today, but we only set `served_from=hosted`. No structured fallback_reason persisted. I propose adding `fallback_reason` enum (capacity|policy|variant_compat).
Julie: Important: billing. Customer was billed Dedicated rates despite being served on Hosted GPUs. We should make billing reflect where it executed. Ops wants to see "Intended pool" and "Actual pool" side-by-side.
Amy: Agreed — UX-wise show both: Intended: Dedicated Tier X, Actual: Hosted (variant v2.1-quant). Tooltip with link to request trace. :link:
Kevin: Telemetry suggestion: new metric `tenant.spillover.count` with labels {tenant, region, fallback_reason, intended_pool, actual_pool}. Alert if (spillover_count / total_requests) > 0.5% for p95 window.
Sai: Implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
route = resolve_route(tenant, model)
if route.is_full:
  emit_trace({served_from: "hosted", fallback_reason: "capacity", intended_pool: route.pool_id, actual_variant: selected_variant})
  emit_metric("tenant.spillover.count", {tenant, region, reason: "capacity"})
```
We need a stable schema so telemetry/console/ billing align.
Marco: Nice. We also need the Console API to accept those labels so customers can filter by "spillover:true". That lets support triage.
Julie: Runbook: if a tenant has >1000 spillovers in 1h or spillover rate >1% and >100 qps, paging to SE + Sales. Also add a SLA note for dedicated customers about potential ephemeral spillover during overload.
Amy: UX: where to put it? Suggest add a small badge next to request timeline: "Served (Intended → Actual)" and a link to the trace. Also add a per-tenant column in the dedicated dashboard: Spillover rate (24h).
Kevin: I'll own the metric pipeline (prom -> alerts -> console). Need the exact label names. Sai, can you standardize on: `fallback_reason`, `intended_pool`, `actual_pool`, `selected_variant`?
Sai: Yes — use those exact keys. Also include `routing_policy_version` so we can audit policy changes.
Infra-bot: deploy pipeline: route-telemetry-schema/v1 -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
Marco: Who will update billing mappings? This is cross-team. We must ensure invoices use actual_pool pricing.
Julie: Billing team notified, but short-term: add a flag in Console export to show which requests were billed hosted vs dedicated so CS can reconcile.
Amy: I'll create Console mockups and a small copy doc explaining the badge and billing implications.
Marco: I'll file the infra PR + RFC with the schema and console API changes. Tagging follow-ups: INF-4523 (schema), UX-998 (console), BILL-21 (billing reconciliation).
Kevin: I'll set provisional alert thresholds and add a dashboard panel.
Marco: Thanks. Quick TODOs: Sai (schema + trace changes), Kevin (metric + alert), Amy (mockups), Julie (runbook + billing contact). I'll shepherd the RFC.
Amy: I'll pair on the mockups tomorrow morning.
Marco: Great. Closing thread unless anyone objects.
